additionalCoursework: CUSM welcomes diverse curricular student backgrounds and does not have specific course requirements, but instead recommends students work towards a solid depth of knowledge in biology, chemistry and physics, mathematics, behavioral and social sciences, communication, and laboratory or field experiments.

medSchoolStudLife.setting:
CUSM-SOM is nestled in between the stately mountains and active cities of the Inland Empire, with Palm Springs, Los Angeles and beautiful Southern California beaches less than an hour away. Whether it’s culture, music, performing arts, sports, world class restaurants and more, the area is positively overflowing with activities for everyone. Our students embrace the rich cultural environment of Southern California by attending events at many of our local museums and theaters. Alongside nearby gardens and hiking hotspots, the natural and cultural centers of the Inland Empire are affordable, nearby, and accessible

The Inland Empire, comprised of San Bernardino and Riverside counties, offers a wide range of  recreational activities. You can spend an afternoon at a vineyard in Temecula or hiking through the beautiful San Bernardino National Forest. Spend the weekend camping around Big Bear Lake or fishing at Lake Arrowhead. You’re a short drive to Southern California’s best ski resorts.
medSchoolStudLife.housing: CUSM-SOM does not offer student dormitory facilities. There are several rental properties available within a 5-mile radius of the campus (20+ apartment complexes) ranging from $900 to $1,600 per month for one to two-bedroom apartments. Most rentals cost an average of $1,400 per month.
medSchoolStudLife.supportSystems: CUSM's Office of Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion serves as a great source of programming and support for gender and sexual minority students.
medSchoolStudLife.campusCulture:
At the California University of Science and Medicine (CUSM), our campus culture can be summarized in one word: TEAM (Together Everyone Achieves More). We are dedicated to fostering an environment where every individual is valued and supported in the pursuit of excellence. Through collaboration, innovation, and community engagement, CUSM creates an inclusive atmosphere that inspires excellence in medical education and research.
With a commitment to service, teamwork, and leadership, we empower students to become compassionate, skilled physicians and healthcare leaders. Our dedication to diversity, equity, and lifelong learning ensures a supportive environment where all members can thrive and contribute to meaningful advancements in the medical field.
medSchoolStudLife.transportationAdditionalInfo: We highly recommend students have transportation.

medSchoolCurriculum.curricularHighlights:
The MD program at the California University of Science and Medicine (CUSM) offers a system based curriculum where the basic science disciplines are taught in the context of clinical presentations.

This allows the student to see firsthand how the basic sciences are linked to the practice of medicine. The curriculum instruction is based on Clinical Presentations (CPs), where integration of the basic science material is the key.

Unlike a traditional medical school, which requires students to wait until their third year of study before they are introduced to clinical reasoning, students at CalMed are introduced to the clinical sciences in their first year, by both basic and clinician scientists.
medSchoolCurriculum.researchPrograms:
The Research Office at CUSM-SOM offers:
 
- Summer Paid Research Opportunities: The summer paid research exposes you to molecular, clinical, and educational research using our state-of-the-art new research facility, library resources, and technology. 

- Academic Research Study (ARS) course: The ARS course relies on the modern data-driven science to train you for big data mining and analysis and prepare you with the skills to navigate publicly available clinical datasets and enhance your future clinical practice and care for your patients.
medSchoolCurriculum.communityServiceText: Students have great opportunities to participate in community service. Our MD program boasts over 70 Registered Student Organizations, many of which participate in community service.
medSchoolCurriculum.researchThesisText: A research project is required. Students are encouraged to participate in additional research opportunities.

medSchoolInformation.generalInformation:
Our Vision is to develop a socially accountable medical school that:

o	Directs its education, research, and service activities towards addressing the priority health concerns and well-being of its 
        community.
o	Inspires, motivates, and empowers students to become excellent and caring physicians, scientists, and leaders.
o	Facilitates a medical education for promising students, especially from California’s Inland Empire.
o	Shares freely with the global community its innovative curriculum and advances of best practices in medical education.
medSchoolInformation.missionStatement: To advance the art and science of medicine through innovative medical education, research, and compassionate healthcare delivery in an inclusive environment that advocates critical thinking, creativity, integrity, and professionalism.

medSchoolApplication.typicalInterviewDay: Students are offered an Video Assessment/Interview based on a holistic review of their entire application, which includes the Secondary Application sent to select applicants.  Additionally, applicants can participate in the virtual Q&A session with faculty to review the CUSM curriculum and research opportunities at CUSM and be invited to participate in a Q&A with  student ambassadors.

medSchoolApplication.videoInterview: Yes, the Video Assessment/Interview is online. Admitted students have the opportunity to attend one of two scheduled "Visit in Person (VIP)" events.

medSchoolApplication.mcatScoresAdditionalInfo: The college has established a minimum composite score of 502 for the MCAT. The average MCAT score among students in our most recent incoming class was 511.
medSchoolApplication.mcatScreenAdditionalInfo: An MCAT 2024 score, no more than 3 years old, is required. An MCAT score of 502 or above is preferred.
medSchoolApplication.gpaScreenAdditionalInfo: CUSM-SOM prefers a total undergraduate GPA of 3.0 or above as well as a BCPM (biology, chemistry, physics, and mathematics) GPA of 3.0 or above.
medSchoolApplication.courseworkAcceptanceInfo: CUSM recognizes the critical role of Community Colleges in offering accessible, high-quality education to students from diverse backgrounds. Consequently, we accept all coursework from regionally accredited community colleges that contribute towards the fulfillment of a four-year undergraduate degree at any US regionally accredited college or university.
medSchoolApplication.technicalStandardInfo:
The Technical Standards section describes the essential abilities required of all candidates *. Upon acceptance, students must attest to their ability to meet those standards with or without reasonable accommodations. Their signature notes this acknowledgment on a copy of the school's Technical Standards.

* A student with a disability must provide a medical report describing the disability and explaining the required accommodation type. CUSM will review the student's disability requirements to determine our ability to provide reasonable accommodations.

medSchoolFinancial.financialAid: CUSM-SOM offers several merit-based and need-based scholarships to recognize and support students with exemplary academic, service, and community accomplishments. This includes 13 full-ride scholarships. For additional scholarship information please check our website.

medSchoolSelection.premedReqRec:
California University of Science and Medicine-School of Medicine (CUSM-SOM) supports the Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC) premise that, “medical schools should promote the least restrictive path to medical school in order to increase the likelihood that students can come from a variety of disciplines, majors, and backgrounds.” To that end, CUSM-SOM has embraced a growing trend found in the nation’s top medical schools to not require any specified prerequisite coursework, while highlighting and recommending courses that we believe would help the successful matriculant navigate our curriculum and prepare them for the practice of medicine.

The prudent student will take care to know and understand the subject matter of the MCAT and set a course of study that leads to mastery of its content. This generally obligates students to take courses in biology, biochemistry, physics, math, multiple laboratory courses as applicable, and English.
medSchoolSelection.oldestPrereqDate: Per our admissions requirements, we do not require any specified prerequisite coursework.
medSchoolSelection.selectionFactors: CUSM uses a holistic process to evaluate our applicants.
